visual.description: Multi-phase counter scene. Phase 1: Counter ticks to 8,000 ('chemicals in textile manufacturing'). Phase 2: Split into '1,900 distinct components' and '150+ hazardous' — two smaller counters. Phase 3: Detection grid — 93 filled cells out of 98 total in a grid layout (each cell represents a target chemical). 93 cells in Accent Pink, 5 empty in Sage. '93/98 detected' label in JetBrains Mono. Dot-grid background.

notes: Opening of Chemical Cocktail section. Three-phase reveal: big number → breakdown → detection grid. The 93/98 grid is a powerful visual — nearly all cells filled. Consider implementing as a small dot grid where each dot represents a chemical, lighting up one by one.
